text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness. To understand the cause, how many days postpartum are you, and have you experienced any chills, foul-smelling lochia, or changes in your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Puerperal Pelvic Thrombophlebitis. The combination of prolonged labor, uterine tenderness, decreased bowel sounds, and postpartum fever strongly suggests this diagnosis over endometritis or UTI.
